description: Shows one short status sentence in the user's Motion tab while work is in progress, so they can tell progress from a stall. kind 'done' marks the job finished and 'problem' marks a blocker; step and of draw a progress bar. Changes nothing else. How it fits the workflow: read_skill {topic:'motion-workflow'}.

kind.description: Omit while working. 'done' ends the job, 'problem' flags a blocker.

of.description: How many there are in total, e.g. 5 — draws a progress bar. Send both or neither, and only when you genuinely know the total; a bar that goes backwards is worse than none.

step.description: Which one you are on, e.g. 2.

text.description: One friendly sentence, first person. Not a log line.

token.description: The session token that connect returned.

name: tell_user
title: Show a status line
